data.body: Independent cold review passed with no findings. Reviewed plan task_01KYA8DZRAM1T1C57W5WWRG8E6 and commit 96c714f. Scope is correct: only the compact/base .hero-background-image art direction changes to translateY(6%) scale(1.07); Hero.tsx, scene/stage/footer/navbar/content/spacing are untouched, and the >=1024px object-position and transform remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Behavioral coverage now geometrically asserts compact top-edge coverage and a calibrated 5–7% bottom overscan in hero-responsive.spec.ts; the shared probe enforces the same bottom-overscan/no-empty-edge contract and reports the ratio. Only the two planned compact Home snapshots changed; expanded/desktop baselines are untouched. Independently reran PW_MATRIX=full pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/hero-responsive.spec.ts --workers=1: 249 passed, 279 intentional skips, 0 failed across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit, covering 320–1920px, 1023/1024 boundary, short landscape, 200% text, and reduced motion. Implementer gates reported green: focused crop 66/66, visual evidence 4 pass/4 intentional skips, typecheck, 160 unit tests, conformance, and build. Inspected fresh native Android evidence: S24-class manifest 2026-07-24T14-54-42-429Z and tablet manifest 2026-07-24T14-59-18-088Z both passed from clean boots with browser-toolbar transition and rotation; S24 native menu, Story CTA, WebGL drag, and node navigation passed. Portrait screenshots at 412x762 and 800x1128 show the ground/tree line meeting the real content viewport bottom with the trailing source margin cropped, no top/side seams, no clipped footer, and preserved FRAC-21 masthead/geometry/blurb/CTA. Landscape screenshots show no seams or horizontal overflow; 1280px tablet landscape retains the unchanged expanded treatment. Acceptance criteria met.
